premise.background: An abandoned hilltop observatory has begun projecting coloured beams onto the town square at midnight.
premise.hook: Watch Captain Haldor asks the party to investigate the dome before panic spreads.

locations.name: Observatory Hill
locations.summary: A windswept knoll topped by a brass-framed glass dome.

locations.name: The Lens Gallery
locations.summary: Circular walkway lined with cracked prisms and a central brass orrery.

actors.name: Captain Haldor
actors.summary: Pragmatic town watch captain who wants the light stopped without burning the dome.

actors.name: Lin
actors.summary: A runaway clockmaker's apprentice hiding beneath the orrery.

factions.name: Hillside Watch
factions.summary: Local constabulary keeping curious townsfolk off the hill.

scenes.title: The Locked Gate
scenes.summary: Captain Haldor hands over a spare key and warns of strange chimes from the dome.

branches.description: Enter the glass dome and climb to the lens gallery.

scenes.title: Beneath the Spinning Lenses
scenes.summary: The orrery turns on its own, casting amber light through a misaligned prism.

clues.text: Chalk marks on the brass rim show someone recently rotated the third prism.

rumours.text: Bakers in the square claim the beam is a comet omen.

items.name: Brass Tuning Key
items.summary: A slotted key that disengages the orrery mainspring.

secrets.text: Lin wound the mainspring while searching for a lost pocket watch and could not stop it.

endings.title: Mainspring Disengaged
endings.description: The beam fades, the dome goes quiet, and Haldor rewards the party.
